theater: 亞歷山大港與尼羅河三角洲

battle.name: 向海明起義
battle.theater: 亞歷山大港與尼羅河三角洲
battle.brief: 公元613年，薩珊帝國將領沙欣與沙赫巴巴茲越過西奈攻入埃及，與希拉克略帝國的守軍在尼羅河三角洲與亞歷山大港一線相持。最能代表守方的是埃及長矛：城牆線上以長矛配盾抵擋波斯騎兵的包抄，地方徵召兵與起義武裝亦持長矛作戰，最終城池因糧援斷絕而陷落。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 薩珊帝國與拜占庭帝國（東羅馬）是這場戰爭的交戰主體，戰端起於薩珊軍隊於公元613年越過西奈、攻入埃及。薩珊方由泰西封的庫思老二世坐鎮，前線由沙欣與沙赫巴巴茲分兵率領，兵種以波斯弓騎兵、鎧甲重騎兵與攻城部隊為主，並有受薩珊支持的巴勒斯坦猶太與撒瑪利亞武裝隨軍行動。拜占庭方由君士坦丁堡的希拉克略統籌，埃及總督諾諾蘇斯率直屬部隊、埃及地方徵召兵與外來傭兵防守亞歷山大港，皇帝另派宦官納爾西斯在東地中海一線牽制薩珊海路。雙方都清楚埃及的分量：這裡供應亞歷山大港的糧秣與船員，也是拜占庭直屬收入與兵源的所在，薩珊要的是切斷東地中海航運，拜占庭要的是保住這條從埃及通往君士坦丁堡的補給線。因此尼羅河三角洲的渡口與亞歷山大港的城牆，成為整場戰爭爭奪最密集的地方。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the Sasanian Empire and the Byzantine, or Eastern Roman, Empire, the clash opening when Sasanian columns crossed Sinai and entered Egypt in 613 CE. On the Sasanian side, Khosrow II held his court at Ctesiphon while the front was carried by Shahin and Shahrbaraz, fielding Persian horse archers, armoured heavy cavalry and siege trains, with the Jewish and Samaritan bands of Palestine aligned to the same cause. On the Byzantine side, Heraclius in Constantinople directed the war as a whole; the governor of Egypt, Nonnosus, commanded imperial detachments, locally raised Egyptian levies and hired mercenary companies in the defence of Alexandria, while the eunuch Narses was sent to tie down the Sasanian sea lanes in the eastern Mediterranean. Both sides understood what Egypt was worth. The province supplied Alexandria with grain and crews and paid the empire direct taxes and recruits, so Sasanian planners wanted to cut the eastern Mediterranean shipping while Byzantine planners wanted to hold open the supply road from Egypt to Constantinople. The Nile delta crossings and the walls of Alexandria therefore became the most heavily contested ground of the whole campaign.
people: 關鍵人物集中在薩珊與拜占庭兩端的最高統帥。薩珊方面，庫思老二世把這場戰爭視為恢復波斯世界霸權的關鍵一步，戰場上的實際推進交給沙欣與沙赫巴巴茲：沙欣領兵在敘利亞戰線連下大馬士革與通往耶路撒冷的城池，沙赫巴巴茲則率騎兵與援軍越過西奈直取埃及，兩人的部隊在約旦河與尼羅河之間拉成一條綿長的攻勢線。拜占庭方面，皇帝希拉克略在610年即位即遇上戰敗，靠著在安納托利亞與美索不達米亞反覆拉鋸才守住帝國核心；埃及總督諾諾蘇斯在薩珊軍進入尼羅河谷之後退守亞歷山大港，組織城防、分配糧秣並維持船隊；宦官納爾西斯在東地中海一線牽制薩珊，後來率軍自敘利亞方向反攻，619年後的戰局扭轉即由他與同僚博努斯一系在東方戰線完成。關於本地起義的首領，存世記載極為零碎，只能確定亞歷山大與三角洲一帶有地方首領率眾兵與薩珊方面往來，其姓名、兵數與相互隸屬關係在不同抄本中互相矛盾，宜存疑而不宜徑信。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sit at the two heads of command, one Sasanian and one Byzantine. On the Sasanian side, Khosrow II treated this war as the step that would restore the Persian world order, and left the actual advance to Shahin and Shahrbaraz. Shahin took Damascus and the roads leading south to Jerusalem on the Syrian front, while Shahrbaraz led cavalry and reinforcements across Sinai straight into Egypt, so that the two columns drew out a single long offensive line between the Jordan and the Nile. On the Byzantine side, Heraclius had inherited defeat when he took the throne in 610 and could keep the core of the empire only by trading blows repeatedly in Anatolia and Mesopotamia. Nonnosus, the governor of Egypt, fell back to Alexandria once the Sasanian columns entered the Nile valley, and there organised the defences, rationed the grain and kept the shipping moving; Narses, the eunuch general, covered the Sasanian flank in the eastern Mediterranean and later counter-attacked from Syria, and the reversal of the war after 619 was carried out by him and his colleague Bonus on the eastern front. As for the leaders of the local rising, the surviving record is extremely thin: all that can be said with confidence is that chiefs in the Alexandria and delta areas raised bands and kept contact with the Sasanian side, and their names, their numbers and the way they were attached to each other contradict one another from one manuscript to another, so they should be treated as doubtful rather than simply believed.
kits: 本卡兵器是埃及長矛（Egyptian spear，約公元前3200年）：青銅矛頭安在木杆上，早王朝時期的埃及步兵靠它在城牆缺口與城牆上抵擋來敵，其後也用來收復失地。在613年的埃及戰役中，這件兵器代表守方最基本也最耐用的一件冷兵器：亞歷山大港的城牆線上，長矛配大盾組成封閉的槍牆，用以擋開波斯重騎兵的衝鋒與攻城塔的接應面；埃及地方徵召兵與受薩珊支持的起義武裝同樣以長矛、木盾與投石為主力，缺少良馬而以密集隊形守住渡口與渠壩。除了長矛，薩珊方投入複合弓、標槍、鎧甲騎兵的鎖子甲與鱗甲、撞車、攻城塔與臨時填壕器械，遠征部隊大量依賴駱駝隊馱載糧秣與柴水；拜占庭方除長槍方陣與披甲騎兵外，還有配重投石機與燃燒油料的擲射器材，以及往返尼羅河與地中海的軍用船隊，港口的糧船與徵召船是城防能否撐下去的最後變數。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Egyptian spear, dated to about 3200 BC: a bronze head bound to a wooden shaft, the implement with which early dynastic Egyptian infantry held city walls and gaps in them, and later went out to recover lost ground. In the Egyptian campaign of 613 it stands for the most basic and most durable cold weapon on the defending side. On the walls of Alexandria, spears paired with large shields formed a closed wall of points used to turn back the charge of Persian heavy cavalry and to cover the working parties at the foot of the siege towers. Egyptian levies and the rising bands aligned with the Sasanians relied on the same combination of spear, wooden shield and slung stones, having few horses and holding the crossings and canal banks in close order. Besides the spear, the Sasanians committed composite bows, javelins, mail and scale armour for their mounted troops, battering rams, siege towers and improvised filling works, while the long columns depended heavily on camel trains to carry grain, fuel and water. The Byzantines fielded pike blocks and fully armoured cavalry, counterweight stone throwers and projectors of burning oil, and kept naval squadrons moving between the Nile and the Mediterranean; the grain ships and the recruitment vessels in the harbour were the last variable on which the defence of the walls turned.
tactics: 薩珊方的打法是波斯人最擅長的一套：以弓騎兵在兩翼展開射擊，用密集箭雨配合鎧甲騎兵的反覆衝鋒切割敵陣，再以假退與再攻的節奏把對手拖進追逐；進入埃及後，遠征隊沿西奈的驛道與水井推進，刻意避開無水的沙丘地帶，逼近尼羅河後立刻控制渡口，切斷亞歷山大與南方省份的聯繫。圍城則按薩珊的老辦法：外圍設寨、內築土壘逼近城牆，同時用撞車對付城門，以攻城塔壓制牆頭守軍，並企圖以掘進的地道削弱牆基。拜占庭守方在城牆上以長矛與盾組成數層槍牆，弓手與投石手配置在後方待命；船隊在港內與地中海之間維持對外通道，援軍則沿海岸與敘利亞陸路北上，試圖切斷薩珊軍的糧道與退路。城最終不是被強攻下來，而是糧道與援軍同時斷絕之後被迫交涉。
tacticsEn: The Sasanians fought in the way Persians had always fought. Horse archers opened on both wings, dense arrow storms worked with the repeated charge of armoured cavalry to cut up the enemy line, and a rhythm of feigned retreat followed by renewed attack dragged the other side into a running pursuit. Once the column was inside Egypt it advanced along the caravan roads and the wells of Sinai, deliberately keeping away from the dry dune country, and as soon as it neared the Nile it seized the crossings to cut Alexandria off from the southern provinces. The siege followed the old Sasanian routine: an outer ring of camps, earthen works driven forward against the walls, rams worked against the gates, siege towers to press the defenders on the parapet, and saps dug in to undermine the foundations. On the Byzantine side the wall was held in several layers of spear and shield, with archers and stone throwers posted in reserve behind them; the squadrons kept the harbour in contact with the Mediterranean, and relief columns moved north along the coast and overland through Syria in an attempt to cut the Sasanian food route and retreat. The city did not fall by storm. It fell when the food route and the relief were both cut and terms had to be negotiated.
data: 關於兵力，現存各種抄本說法互有出入，只能給出量級而非確數：薩珊投入埃及的遠征軍被描述為數萬人等級，其中相當一部分是弓騎兵與隨軍的非戰鬥人員；亞歷山大港的守軍則是數千人規模，由拜占庭直屬兵、埃及徵召兵與雇傭兵混合組成。距離方面，從大馬士革或敘利亞前線到亞歷山大港，行程約一千二百至一千四百公里，其中穿越西奈的沙漠段最耗人力畜力，薩珊軍只能依靠預置的駱駝隊與沿途水井維持。時間線大致可排：613年薩珊在敘利亞得手後向埃及推進，614年占領耶路撒冷並把真十字架帶往泰西封，616至617年間薩珊軍進抵亞歷山大港並完成合圍，619年城池陷落，埃及在薩珊統治下維持到628至629年，629年拜占庭重新收復。攻城階段的損失集中在攻城器械與糧秣：遠征隊的攻城器材多在潟湖與沙地之間難以運轉，糧水不足使包圍方自身先陷入困境。
dataEn: On numbers, the surviving copies disagree with one another, so only orders of magnitude can be given rather than exact figures. The Sasanian expedition into Egypt is described as being on the scale of tens of thousands, a large part of them horse archers and non combatants moving with the army. The garrison of Alexandria was on the scale of several thousand, mixed imperial detachments, Egyptian levies and mercenary companies. As for distance, the march from Damascus or the Syrian front to Alexandria runs to somewhere between twelve hundred and fourteen hundred kilometres, the desert crossing of Sinai being the most costly stretch in men and animals, and the Sasanian column could only keep itself going with pre-positioned camel trains and the wells along the route. The chronology can be set out roughly like this: in 613 the Sasanians, having won in Syria, drove on into Egypt; in 614 they took Jerusalem and carried the True Cross away to Ctesiphon; between 616 and 617 the columns reached Alexandria and closed the investment; in 619 the city fell; Egypt stayed in Sasanian hands until 628 and 629, when the Byzantines recovered it. The losses of the siege period fall on the siege equipment and the supplies: much of the assault train could not be moved at all between the lagoons and the sand, and the shortage of food and water made the besiegers suffer before the besieged did.
cause: 導火線是薩珊對拜占庭的整體攻勢。602年庫思老二世以拜占庭使節在邊境被殺、皇帝馬爾科斯不肯懲兇為由開戰，宣稱要為受迫害的波斯人雪恥；前線節節失守、首都一度淪陷，使拜占庭在敘利亞與美索不達米亞的屏障一再退卻。希拉克略即位後靠多次反擊收復美索不達米亞與泰西封，卻因遠征消耗與帝國東西兩線同時受敵而無法把優勢轉為全勝，613年之後形勢逆轉，薩珊重新奪回敘利亞與巴勒斯坦。埃及之所以首當其衝，一方面是薩珊要切斷拜占庭的糧源與東地中海航線，另一方面是當地受壓迫的猶太與撒瑪利亞社群把薩珊的推進視為翻身的機會，地方首領於是起兵配合；拜占庭在埃及的守備本來就偏薄，僅靠諾諾蘇斯所率的守軍與亞歷山大城牆硬撐，這正是這場在史籍中以「向海明起義」為名、被記錄為地方起義與反攻的戰役的背景。
causeEn: The trigger was the general Sasanian offensive against Byzantium. In 602 Khosrow II went to war over the killing of a Persian ambassador on the frontier and the refusal of the emperor Maurice to punish those responsible, claiming that he would avenge the Persians persecuted for their faith. Frontier defeats and the loss of the capital pushed the Byzantine shield in Syria and Mesopotamia back again and again. Heraclius recovered Mesopotamia and Ctesiphon by repeated counterstrokes after his accession, but long marches, exhausted reserves and pressure on two fronts at once kept him from turning that advantage into a general victory, and after 613 the situation turned again as the Sasanians retook Syria and Palestine. Egypt stood in the path for two reasons. The Sasanians needed to cut the Byzantine food supply and the shipping of the eastern Mediterranean, and the oppressed Jewish and Samaritan communities of the province read the Sasanian advance as their chance to turn the tables, so local chiefs rose and cooperated with the invaders. The Byzantine garrison in Egypt was thin to begin with, and the wall of Alexandria with the troops under Nonnosus was all that stood in the way, which is the background to the rising recorded in the chronicles under the name given to this campaign.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠及地中海與中東。耶路撒冷陷落後，真十字架被帶往泰西封，成為薩珊在宗教與象徵層面最耀眼的戰利品，與此前波斯控制埃及的傳統記憶接上，使薩珊在陸上與海上的攻勢在數代人之後仍被記得；希拉克略雖因長期戰役而名聲更盛，帝國的邊疆卻被推到尼羅河與幼發拉底河之間，錢糧與兵員的調度自此緊張。埃及脫離拜占庭約十五年，其間的行政、司法與徵兵由薩珊任命的官吏與地方首領處理，拜占庭的希臘化城市秩序受到衝擊，而受壓迫的社群之間的舊怨也隨占領與反攻而累積。629年拜占庭收復埃及後，這片土地隨即在數年內落入阿拉伯征服的浪潮，亞歷山大港的航運地位改由拜占庭與新生的阿拉伯海軍共同決定；從更長的視角看，這場戰爭是薩珊與拜占庭長期消耗中的一段插曲，也是希拉克略得以東征並最終扭轉局勢的轉折起點。
impactEn: The consequences of the campaign reached far across the Mediterranean and the Middle East. After Jerusalem fell the True Cross was carried to Ctesiphon and became the most glittering Sasanian trophy on the religious and symbolic plane, fitting into the older memory of Persian possession of Egypt, and the land and sea offensive of the Sasanians was still remembered several generations later. Heraclius gained in renown from the long war, yet the frontier of the empire was pushed back to a line between the Nile and the Euphrates, and the strain of moving money, grain and recruits never eased. Egypt was separated from Byzantium for roughly fifteen years; during that time administration, justice and recruitment were in the hands of officials appointed from Ctesiphon and of local chiefs, the Hellenic order of the Byzantine cities was shaken, and old grievances between the oppressed communities accumulated through the occupation and the counter attacks. When the Byzantines recovered Egypt in 629, the province passed within a few years into the Arab conquests, and the shipping position of Alexandria came to be shared between Byzantine fleets and the new Arab navy. Seen from further back, this campaign is one episode in the long attritional struggle between the Sasanians and Byzantium, and the turning point from which Heraclius was able to march east and eventually reverse the war.
result: 結果是薩珊在埃及取得了軍事上的完整勝利：亞歷山大港在糧援斷絕、援軍不至的情況下陷落，埃及與利萬提亞實際落入薩珊統治，直到628年局勢逆轉、629年才被拜占庭將領重新奪回。所謂「向海明起義」，作為地方武裝在薩珊軍推進時的配合與抵抗，在亞歷山大陷落後失去掩體與補給，隨之瓦解；此後的編年史多以「薩珊征服埃及」或「613年埃及戰役」稱呼這一段，而把起義的部分記作附帶的插曲。戰局之所以能逆轉，關鍵不在埃及而在美索不達米亞：628年庫思老二世被弒，其子一度重啟戰事卻立刻敗退，繼位的薩珊君主在631至632年間與拜占庭達成和議，薩珊軍隊退出小亞細亞與埃及。希拉克略則在628至629年間由東方戰線反攻，重新奪回埃及與利萬提亞，於是「向海明起義」所屬的那一頁，最後還是由拜占庭收場；此後再過十餘年，埃及便轉入阿拉伯征服的軌道，這場起義與其後的薩珊占領期，成為地中海東岸漫長角力中的一段前史。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete military victory for the Sasanians in Egypt. Alexandria fell with its supply cut off and no relief arriving, and Egypt and Libya passed in practice under Sasanian rule until the situation turned in 628 and the Byzantines took the province back in 629. The rising called the Revolt towards the Sea, insofar as it was the local bands that cooperated with and resisted the Sasanian advance, lost its cover and its supplies once the city had fallen and came apart with it. Later chronicles therefore describe this stretch mostly as the Sasanian conquest of Egypt, or the Egyptian campaign of 613, and treat the rising itself as a side episode. What reversed the war was not Egypt but Mesopotamia. Khosrow II was killed in 628; his son reopened the war for a moment and was beaten at once, and the Sasanian monarch who followed reached an agreement with Byzantium between 631 and 632 and withdrew his armies from Asia Minor and Egypt. Heraclius counter-attacked from the eastern front between 628 and 629 and took Egypt and Libya back, so that the chapter to which this rising belongs was closed by Byzantium. A little over a decade later Egypt moved onto the track of the Arab conquest, and this rising together with the Sasanian occupation that followed it became one of the preludes to the long struggle over the eastern Mediterranean shore.
